intents.description: Closes the currently open channel and returns to the channel list. Mirrors the toolbar back button used on mobile/narrow layouts.

Shares one or more entities into a chat as rich, interactive cards — Rooms, Groups, Communities, Meetings, or Contacts — instead of plain links. Pass "id" for a single card or "ids" for several in one message. All cards in one call must be the SAME cardType (mixed types need separate calls). Posts into the currently open channel by default; pass channelId to target a specific channel.

required.name: cardType
required.description: The entity type to share: "room", "group", "community", "meeting", or "contact". Applies to every id in this call.

optional.name: id
optional.description: A single entity id to share (room/group/community id, user id for a contact, or — for meetings — the occurrence id from list-events; a one-off meeting id also works). Use this OR "ids".

optional.name: ids
optional.description: Several entity ids to share as multiple cards in one message — all of the given cardType (for meetings, occurrence ids from list-events). Use this OR "id".

optional.name: channelId
optional.description: Target channel id. Defaults to the currently active channel.

optional.name: networkId
optional.description: The network the entities belong to. Defaults to the active network.

intents.description: Read-only. Returns a snapshot of what the chat is currently showing — the channels list, an open channel, or both side by side (wide layout) — plus the in-app back action. Lets non-web clients (e.g. the Android device back button) mirror the toolbar back-button navigation. Changes nothing. Returns { view: "list" | "channel" | "list-and-channel", isWide, activeChannelId, openThreadId, threadTakeover, canNavigateBack, backAction: "close-thread" | "close-channel" | null }.
Sets the text‑chat view layout (e.g. wide or narrow mode).

required.name: isWide
required.description: Whether to enable wide‑mode layout in the chat view.

intents.description: Opens an AI‑powered chat session scoped to a specific room.

required.name: roomId
required.description: The unique identifier of the room in which to start the AI chat.

intents.description: Sends a rich text message to a text-chat channel on behalf of an initiator (e.g. an AI agent or automated service). Silent — does NOT open or change the visible chat. Use channelId when you know it; otherwise provide userId for a direct message.

required.name: text
required.description: The message body to send.

optional.name: channelId
optional.description: Target channel ID. Takes precedence over userId.

optional.name: userId
optional.description: Target user ID for a direct message. Ignored if channelId is provided.

optional.name: buttons
optional.description: Optional interactive buttons to attach to the message as a rich card.

intents.description: Shows the contextual profile card for a user.

optional.description: The application the card is opened from, and so the view a native host should present it above (e.g. "textchat"). Absent when the caller could not name one — present over the topmost view in that case.

intents.description: Opens the Valu Guru app on a chat with the built-in Valu Guru assistant, without sending anything. Resumes the most recent built-in-assistant conversation, or lands on the empty new-chat screen when there is none. Custom chatbot conversations are never resumed, and nothing is created on the server — a session appears only once a message is sent.

optional.name: newChat
optional.description: When true, always lands on the empty new-chat screen instead of resuming the most recent Valu Guru conversation.

intents.description: Opens the Valu Guru app and starts a brand-new conversation session with an initial message. Always creates a new session regardless of existing ones.

required.name: message
required.description: The initial user message to send in the new session.

optional.name: chatbotId
optional.description: Chatbot ID to start the session with. Accepts a personal "my chatbots" id, a published LIBRARY chatbot id (auto-added to "my chatbots" if not already there), or 'default'. Defaults to the default Valu Guru chatbot ('default').

required.description: The chat session ID to open.

intents.description: Opens the Valu Guru app on the Chatbot Library — the browse list of published chatbots, not one chatbot's detail page (that is open-chatbot). Pass `tags` to land with the tag filter already applied, so the grid shows only the chatbots carrying those tags. Several tags NARROW the result (a chatbot must carry all of them). Matching is case-insensitive, and a tag no published chatbot in this network uses is dropped rather than leaving an empty grid.

optional.name: tags
optional.description: Discovery tags to pre-select in the library's tag filter (e.g. ["Shabbat"]). Omit to open the library unfiltered.

intents.description: Opens the Valu Guru app on a library chatbot's detail page. Unlike open-chat, the target is not personal — any user in the network can view it (used e.g. by the bot badge on shared chatbot replies).

required.name: chatbotId

intents.description: Opens the Valu Guru app on the new-chatbot creation wizard, optionally pre-filled. Pass `instructions` to land on the Design step fully filled in, or just `prompt` to land on the Describe step with the task pre-typed and ready to generate.

optional.description: Plain-language task description to seed the Describe step (e.g. "a bot that answers HR policy questions"). Ignored if `instructions` is also given.

optional.name: instructions
optional.description: Full system-prompt instructions for the chatbot. When given, the wizard opens straight on the Design step instead of Describe.

optional.name: name
optional.description: Chatbot display name.

optional.name: description
optional.description: Short chatbot description shown in the library/list.

optional.name: icon
optional.description: Font Awesome icon class (e.g. "fa-light fa-robot") or a DiceBear avatar URL.

optional.name: skillIds
optional.description: IDs of skills (from the shared Skills Catalogue) to pre-select for the chatbot.
